children.text: The Ireland tourist visa allows the holder a short-term tourist visit to Ireland.
Starting May 12, 2025, important changes have been made for Georgian residents wishing to obtain a visa to travel to Ireland. The new procedure will simplify and speed up the application process.

page.title: How to apply for a visa?

children.text:
Previously, Georgian citizens had to submit their Irish visa application at the Irish Embassy in Sofia (Bulgaria).
Now, all applications are processed by the Irish Embassy in Ankara (Turkey).

content.text: Documents no longer need to be sent by mail:

children.text: As a result of this change, you no longer need to send your documents abroad by mail.
Georgian citizens now have the option to submit their application in Tbilisi at the newly opened VFS Global Visa Application Centre (VAC).

To apply, the following steps must be completed:

🔹 Gathering the required documents.
🔹 Registering on the VFS Global website and booking an appointment.
🔹 Visiting VFS Global.
🔹 Paying the visa center service fee and the visa fee.
🔹 Receiving the visa decision.
Processing of the Ireland visa application begins once the documents are submitted and takes 2 to 5 weeks.
This depends on the length of stay you request. In most cases, the consulate issues visas with the following validity: 1 month, 3 months, and 1 year.

page.title: How long is the visa valid?

children.text: Visa application form
A valid passport (valid for at least 6 more months)
Flight reservation
Proof of accommodation
Documents confirming financial means
Police clearance certificate
Additional documentation (invitation letter, motivation letter, and others).
Make sure to include all required information in your application.
Make sure your passport is valid for at least six months from your planned return date.
If you have additional supporting documents, submit them to the consulate translated and certified.
It's recommended to submit your visa application 3-6 months before your trip, as the consulate handles a high volume of applications.
The motivation letter must include the following text:
"I will observe the conditions of my visa. I will not become a burden on the State and I will leave the State on the expiry of my permission to remain."
The consulate reserves the right to request additional documentation from the applicant.
It's important to remember, and not exceed, the rights and obligations granted by your visa category.

There are several reasons for an Ireland visa refusal, though the main factors that most often determine the decision relate to how well the applicant can demonstrate their intent to return to their home country and how well they meet all required financial and documentary requirements.
Insufficient ties to home country:

one of the most common reasons for a visa refusal is when the applicant cannot demonstrate sufficient ties to their home country, suggesting they might not return home and could remain in Ireland unlawfully.
Insufficient financial resources:
the consul must be convinced that the applicant has enough financial means to cover all expenses of travel and their stay in Ireland.
Incorrect or insufficient documents:
incomplete or incorrectly filled-out documents can lead to a visa refusal. It's important that all requested documents are submitted complete and correct.
Limited travel history:
if the applicant lacks sufficient prior travel history demonstrating responsibility and proof of return, the visa may be refused.

content.text: What determines whether I'll get a visa?

children.text: It's difficult to predict the likelihood of a specific applicant being granted a visa. However, it's clear that this depends on your close ties to your home country. Clear proof of your travel purpose is also important.

content.text: Can the decision on an Ireland visa be guaranteed or challenged?

children.text: No one else can interfere with the consul's decision on issuing a visa. This decision is final. However, our qualified professionals will do everything possible to prepare your documents properly and in your favor for the consulate, so the consul fully understands your current circumstances and prospects, which increases the likelihood of the visa being granted.

content.text: How long does it take to receive the visa?

children.text: The visa is issued within 2 to 5 weeks of submitting the documents.

content.text: Is it necessary to visit the Irish consulate in Bulgaria to submit documents?

children.text: No, it isn't necessary. You can send the documents via courier.

content.text: Which Irish consulate issues the Ireland visa in Bulgaria?

children.text: The Irish consulate in Bulgaria issues visas for Ireland, whose capital is Dublin. For a Northern Ireland visa, the application is made at the UK Visa Application Centre.
